Janta dal (yunaited) ne rashtriy sangthan men bara pherabdal kiya hai. rashtriy adhyaksh ki manjuri se jari suchi men chandeshvar prasad chandravanshi, shyam rajak, manish kumar varma aur shravan kumar samet kaee diggajon ko aham jimmedariyan saunpi gaee hain.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
